notes.title: Acclaim rises from the dead, with help from the founder of Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion's publisher, and a guy who once said "It's Mr Slap Nuts to you"
notes.notes:
Remember Acclaim, the publisher of a bunch of classic 90s games including NBA Jam, Turok, and the original Mortal Kombat (alongside Midway), declaring bankruptcy in 2004? Well, it's being ressurected as a fresh venture which will aim to "support indie developers and reignite classic franchises". No, we don't know if it'll be doing stuff like offering people cash and an Xbox to change their name to Mr Turok this time.

Read more

notes.title: Turnip Boy Robs A Bank review: continuing Turnip Boy's story in slightly chaotic roguelite style
notes.notes:
Readers may remember how much I liked Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion, principally because of how funny it was. It was an intelligent and somewhat loving take on a Zelda-y RPG - a small town hero gets a sword and goes on a rampage fighting some bosses - except the main character is a turnip. And also he tears up any paperwork handed to him. Turnip Boy Robs A Bank follows directly on from his Tax Evasion, and it's not quite as funny or as focused, but it's also an entirely different genre of game, and I have a huge amount respect for that.

Read more

notes.title: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank review
notes.notes: You know that scene at the end of the Scott Pilgrim movie where he's having to do the whole Chaos Theatre shtick a second time, breezing through security with just a couple of punches and some hurtful words? It was kinda badass, and that's how I felt after a couple of hours into Turnip Boy Robs a Bank. Though instead of a morally questionable 23-year-old Canadian, I'm a morally questionable root vegetable... Read more.

notes.title: Turnip Boy Robs a Demo?
notes.notes:
From now until [b]Monday, October 16th[/b], you can get your thieving mitts on the demo for the upcoming [b]Turnip Boy Robs a Bank[/b] as a part of the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].

How much chaos can you cause in the Veggieville bank before the fuzz swarms the building? Will you successfully loot the vaults of their riches without getting the beatdown? [i]And where in the world are you going to keep all that moolah if you're a turnip without any pockets?[/i]

You'll have to play the demo in order to find out! Ooooor you could just watch the repeating video on our Steam page instead... BUT we'd recommend checking out the game for yourselves.

And if you REALLY feel sporting, then maybe you could share some feedback with us on what you think of the demo. You can add your thoughts and opinions to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2097230/discussions/]Steam Discussions tab[/url] or pop by the official [url=https://snoozykazoo.com/discord.html]Snoozy Kazoo Discord[/url] to share your impressions or experiences in the demo.

We hope you all enjoy playing/watching the demo and appreciate you checking it out!

notes.title: Turnip Boy is Back in Turnip Boy Robs a Bank!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone from all of us at Snoozy Kazoo!

We know you’ve all been clamoring for some more Turnip Boy, and today we’re excited to announce Turnip Boy Robs a Bank with our publisher pal Graffiti Games!! It has all the comedic action-adventure gameplay you loved in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205450/Turnip_Boy_Commits_Tax_Evasion/]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/url] plus some roguelite elements. 

In Robs a Bank you’ll team up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time. Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, battle the fuzz, and use wacky tools bought off the dark web to move further into the vaults of the Botanical Bank.

[previewyoutube=_TaQk2qvudo;full][/previewyoutube]

Wishlisting the game helps us a ton, so please Wishlist if you can. 

And if you want to stay updated on all things Turnip Boy, please follow Snoozy Kazoo on [url=https://twitter.com/snoozykazoo]Twitter[/url] or join the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/jMnjkAS]Discord[/url].

LET’S GOOOOO!
